summary: DriveMate Iteration 2 fully verified. Backend: 9/9 iter2 pytest + 9/9 iter1 regression pass. Endpoints tested: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/vehicles, POST /api/vehicles/{id}/service, slot completion side-effect (+1h to total_hours & hours_since_service), Fleet-03 auto-flag to Service Due, POST /api/slots/{id}/send-reminder on Booked (200 with sent_to/sent_at) and 400 on Available/Completed, POST /api/slots/run-reminders returns {sent, skipped}, GET /api/instructor/stats now includes fleet_count/fleet_service_due. Frontend: Login/Footer/Header/Sidebar contain no CPUT anywhere; Sidebar shows Fleet Manager (sidebar-fleet) between Calendar Slots and Profile; FleetManager renders seeded vehicles; Fleet-03 shows amber SERVICE DUE badge and orange Mark Serviced button — clicking it reset the counter (108/100 -> 0/100) and flipped status to Active; Add Vehicle modal creates a vehicle and it appears in the grid; SlotScheduler has List/Week toggle, Week view (scheduler-week-view) renders 7-day x hourly grid (72 cells), prev/next buttons work, empty week-cell click opens Add Slot modal with date/time prefilled; List view Send (paper-plane) icon exists only on Booked rows (2/5 in seed); Run 24h Reminders button triggers bulk endpoint and shows toast 'Reminder job: sent 0, skipped 2' (expected because seeded slots are 1-3 days away, not within 22-26h window).

minor.issue: When Emergent Resend proxy returns non-2xx (observed intermittent 502 during UI test), backend returns raw 502 with detail 'Failed to send email'; the frontend toast shows the Cloudflare HTML 'The origin web server returned an invalid or incomplete response to Cloudflare' instead of a friendly message. Consider catching the axios error and toasting 'Reminder could not be sent right now'.

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' during Week view render. Non-breaking but should be fixed by adding key={} on the mapped week rows/columns.

integration_issues.issue: When Emergent Resend proxy is unreachable (502), toast displays raw Cloudflare HTML instead of a friendly error string. Wrap slotApi.sendReminder rejection in a normalized message.

action_items: (Optional/Low) Add stable key prop to Week view row/column .map to silence React key warning in SlotScheduler.jsx.
(Optional/Low) Normalize send-reminder error toast so a 502 from the Resend proxy renders a friendly message instead of the raw Cloudflare HTML body.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py VehicleUpdate model correctly excludes hours_since_service/total_hours (immutable via PATCH) — good design; document this so clients don't try to set them.
server.py _handle_slot_side_effects only increments on 'Completed' transition from a non-Completed state (idempotent) — correct.

server.py POST /api/slots/{id}/send-reminder raises 502 on send failure but the frontend surfaces the raw upstream HTML in a toast; catch and normalize the error message on the client (SlotScheduler.jsx).
SlotScheduler.jsx: React 'unique key' warning in Week view — add key on the mapped week rows/columns.
seed_data in server.py now uses relative dates (today+1..+3); good for demos but reminder loop will always show skipped=N until slots fall inside the 22-26h window — expected per instructions.
test_credentials: MongoDB session token 'test_drivemate_token_2026' (Bearer + cookie) as documented.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests leave a couple of TEST_-prefixed slots/vehicles; UI test also created 'UI_TEST_<ts>' vehicle. All are cleanly named with TEST_/UI_TEST_ prefix and safe to purge. Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 fully verified. Fleet Manager and Reminders are wired end-to-end. Emergent Resend proxy is reachable most of the time (returns 200 sent_to/sent_at) but occasionally returns 502 — both are acceptable per the review request. Sidebar testids: sidebar-roster, sidebar-scheduler (NOT sidebar-slots), sidebar-fleet, sidebar-profile. Week cells testid uses YYYY-MM-DD-HH:MM; week slots have testid week-slot-{id}. Add Slot modal opens on empty week-cell click with prefilled date/time.
